figures.caption: Figure 1: PCIe contention on PCIe-based nodes during distributed DiT inference. (a) H2D prefetch and inter-GPU collectives converge at each GPU’s PCIe receive port (Rx) and contend for bandwidth. (b) Denoising step latency breakdown: the contention stall (21%) accounts for a large portion.
Figure 3: Denoising step time (top) and GPU peak memory (bottom) across frame and batch sizes

Figure 2: Block-level timing under (a) no offload, (b) whole-layer layerwise offload, and (c) our communication-aware chunked prefetch, illustrated on a DiT block with Ulysses sequence parallelism. Substituting the compute and prefetch models above, the overlap condition can be written directly in terms of the block-level compute workload Fblock.
